title: Evaluation statistics robustness: refusals never rewarded, pooled attempt-adjusted score with interval, exact sign test, insufficient verdict, official vs exploratory tier, version-aware baseline (REQ-0071)
acceptance_criteria: AC2 validation scenarios on synthetic runs

design.summary: Refusals never rewarded (non-answered keyed items score 0), outcome partition, pooled kind aggregate, exact sign test, insufficient/unmeasured verdicts, official vs exploratory tier, version-aware baseline

implementation.summary: 64.1-64.7: non-answered keyed items score 0, outcome partition, pooled kind aggregate, exact sign test, insufficient/unmeasured verdicts, official vs exploratory tier, version-aware baseline

unit_test.result: 1244 tests, only baseline failures; independent p-values and Wilson intervals match code and design; golden diffs only the intended wording and board-key changes; 6/6 mutations killed; real run2->run3 compare unmeasured, board tier exploratory, never better

security.result: no finding; pure statistics over saved results, no key read outside scorer

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; independent p-value and Wilson recomputation; golden old/new outputs
verification.result: 64.1-64.7 verified: 1245 tests, failures = the 4 known baseline names (docx textbox, check_examples 12b + dgnl pairing, req0012 cwd, scripts_exam); independent p-values and Wilson intervals match; 6/6 mutations killed; golden diffs only the intended wording and board-key changes; verifier D1 (denominator included declined open/no-key items) fixed; limits: official tier empty until REQ-0072, runs written before TASK-064 must be re-scored (L1), benchmark.py regression rule G9 out of scope, no real keyed run
